intro: Professionals and everyday users convert kilometers per hour (km/h) to meters per second (m/s) when working across metric and si standards in automotive speedometer readings, aviation airspeed navigation, maritime chart plotting, and meteorology. One kilometers per hour equals 0.277778 meters per second, while 1 meters per second equals 3.6 kilometers per hour. Whether you are verifying speed specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Kilometers per Hour to Meters per Second is 0.27777778, derived from the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement (1 inch = 25.4 mm, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg).

In structural engineering, CNC machining, or bulk inventory totals, rounding the multiplier to 2 decimal places too early can introduce cumulative tolerance errors; always compute with the full factor and round only the final displayed figure.

faqs.question: How many meters per second (m/s) are in 1 kilometers per hour (km/h)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.27777778 meters per second (m/s) in 1 kilometers per hour (km/h), which rounds to 0.2778 m/s for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 meters per second equals 3.6 kilometers per hour.

faqs.question: How do I convert kilometers per hour to meters per second (km/h to m/s)?
faqs.answer: To convert kilometers per hour to meters per second, use the formula: m/s = km/h × 0.27777778. For example, converting 10 km/h gives 2.7778 m/s.

faqs.question: What is 10 kilometers per hour in meters per second?
faqs.answer: 10 kilometers per hour (km/h) equals exactly 2.7778 meters per second (m/s) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
